follow_up_tasks.summary: Add a read-only MCP tool aiworkhub_task_audit_log that returns the last N audit entries, useful for dashboard/health checks.
Add audit log rotation (max size / max age) so the log doesn't grow unbounded on long-running servers.
Add optional alert threshold: if blocked attempts exceed N/hour, surface via health tool or stderr. Keeps MCP agent aware of misconfiguration.

notes: All follow-ups are read-only or passive additions. None enable writes or agent launch by default. The audit log itself is append-only and defensive — it cannot be used to bypass the write gate.
